findings.evidence: Lines 164-170: `simp [...] at h₂ h₃ h₄` then `refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩` / `linear_combination h₂` etc. — the tactic consuming the hypotheses depends on their post-simp form.
findings.fix: Make it `simp only [...]` with the (already explicit) lemma list, extended with whatever arithmetic/zero-clearing lemmas the expansion needs, so only named rewrites are used; keep the explanatory comment.
findings.issue: `simp [coeff_subst_eq_sum_range …, Finset.sum_range_succ, coeff_mul, …] at h₂ h₃ h₄` is a non-terminal call with the *full* default simp set; the three following `linear_combination h₂ / h₃ / h₄` only close their goals if simp leaves h₂/h₃/h₄ in a ring-equivalent shape. Any change to the ambient simp set silently breaks the lemma, and nothing in the proof pins the normal form.

findings.evidence: grep `:= \(rfl\)` → only the two new files (8 hits); grep `:= rfl$` → 58 hits in 19 pre-existing files; no script in `scripts/` or `.github/` matches on `rfl`.
findings.fix: Write `:= rfl`, matching the rest of the repo (and, for the two sites crossing a wrapper, the named lemmas requested above).
findings.issue: All eight pure-unfolding lemmas in the PR are written `:= (rfl)` (Substitution.lean:113, 117, 121, 164, 183; BetaFunction.lean:91, 101, 235). The parenthesised form appears nowhere else in the repo, which uses `:= rfl` in 58 places across 19 files, and nothing documents the deviation.

summary: Two proof-robustness issues: a non-terminal default-simp-set call whose output shape three subsequent `linear_combination`s depend on, and rfl/`exact` proofs that cross the `IsUnit.unit` and `MonoidHom` coercion wrappers by definitional equality where named lemmas exist. Everything else (linear_combination usage, proof lengths, factoring) is fine.
